name: Thompson Shanghai Expo
positioning: Thompson Shanghai Expo, by Hyatt: a hotel at Expo Place in the Shanghai World Expo area, with city and Huangpu River views, a rooftop club and a Chinese seafood restaurant
best_for: Travelers who want to stay close to the China Art Museum in the Expo area
Guests who like rooftop cocktails and river views under the same roof

facts.text: Thompson Shanghai Expo is located at Expo Place, a commercial complex in the Shanghai World Expo area.
The hotel's design is inspired by the area's industrial heritage.
Guest rooms feature artworks inspired by the Expo Pavilion.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with city and Huangpu River views.
Suites include a Golden Hours benefit and turndown service.
TOTS serves specialty cocktails with Italian tapas and Chinese snacks, to a soundtrack of DJ music.
TOTS has cabanas with tableside service.
Fishermen's Pavilion has views of the Huangpu River and the Shanghai skyline.
BAOBAO Lounge, the lobby lounge, serves steamed delicacies and light bites.
The hotel has a heated indoor pool, plus sauna and steam rooms.
The Oval is an event space with a curved design.
The China Art Museum is 0.45 km from the hotel.

highlights.text: TOTS, the hotel's rooftop club destination, has a 270-degree view.
The Pavilion View king room looks out on the red structure of the China Art Museum, originally China's World Expo Pavilion.
Fishermen's Pavilion serves Chinese cuisine built around seafood and freshwater fish from five coastal and riverine regions.
The Metropolitan Suite is on the 18th floor and has a separate living room and bedroom.
Thompson Hall, the ballroom, spans 1,100 square meters.

considerations.text: The hotel provides a limited selection of disposable in-room amenities on request and recommends guests bring their own essentials.
The hotel recommends local mapping apps such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map, as international mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.
